import json,random
random.seed(1)
hi=0xdeadbeefcafebabe
vals=set()
while len(vals)<8192:vals.add(random.getrandbits(64))
ops=[]
for i,lo in enumerate(vals):ops.append(['put',f'{hi:016x}{lo:016x}',128,i])
# add some lower prefixes within same group to trigger locals
for l in range(65,128):
 a=(hi<<64)|random.getrandbits(64);p=(a>>(128-l))<<(128-l)
 ops.append(['put',f'{p:032x}',l,l])
# exceed puts; trim? 8192 +63 =8255 > max. Remove first 63 full
ops=ops[63:]
print('puts',len(ops))
for s in range(3):ops.append(['save'])
ops.append(['load_saved',0])
ops.append(['query',[f'{random.getrandbits(128):032x}' for _ in range(100000)]])
open('/tmp/stress2_req.json','w').write(json.dumps({'cases':[{'ops':ops}]}))
PY
